name: Star Swarm
description: Themable Galaga-style fixed shooter rendered on a canvas. No database, no migrations, no tables.
author: HARPP v2

exemptions.reason: Anonymous public game page. Dispatch authority is fail-closed and refuses callers with an empty actor role (CD-56 Finding 1), so a capability declaration would 403 every visitor. The handler reads no tenant data; it renders a static DiSyL template and injects theme design tokens.

Trailing-slash anonymous public game page. Same exemption as GET /star-swarm: dispatch refuses empty-role callers, the handler reads no tenant data, and the page must be reachable without a login or a database write.
